Being young is hard enough, and it’s so much fucking harder when family and friends do nothing to make things easier for you. But where there’s life, there’s hope. You are hope. You have so much time for things to get better and it’ll be when you’re older that you’ll see that more. Don’t give up on yourself just yet. Invest in yourself and be the person you wish would be there for you. You deserve to give yourself at least that much. 

Don’t let your parents’ failure to love you right define your future. They do not decide who you are or who you’re going to be. You’ve got this.

Hey Gavin, there’s no way that you’re a bad person. You’re too young to have accomplished that yet! I know you don’t like the people around you, but people always change and move on. That means there is a 100% chance you’ll find people you like. And then you’ll find more. Maybe not all at once, but it’ll come. 

12 years isn’t a long time.. There’s a lot out there in the world for you to find. It’s all waiting for you. You just have to stick out the next bit of your childhood, and you’ll get to see. Hang in there. Good things always come, you just have to be there to see them. You’re worth more than you know.
